serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: You see, I loved this city. I lived somewhere else before, but I felt like I was drowning there. No friends, no hobbies, nothing to do. My life felt empty.
Lady Annalie: I heard many things about this megacity, good and bad, and I sacrificed a lot to get here. I found friends and passion, but over the last few years I feel like it all slipped away.
Lady Annalie: Don’t get me wrong, I love my shop and my clients, but over the years, I’ve lost more clients than I’ve gained.
Lady Annalie: You were a breath of fresh air. 
Lady Annalie: Out of my huge group of friends almost no one is still around. Occasionally they come to visit, but it’s nowhere near enough for me to feel satisfied.
Lady Annalie: If you two leave too, I don’t know what I will do…
#bot.Expression.verysad
Bot: Don’t cry, Annalie!
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.veryangry
Bot: Look at what you did!
You: What I did?! I didn’t even say a word!
Bot: I think you should leave now.
You: What do you mean?! 
Bot: I will find my way home, don’t worry.
You: …
